setting.agent: The agent for new chats: empty for your school's, or an id from bulkhours.extraAgents.
setting.extraAgents: Your own ACP agents: { id, label, command, args, env }. Values may use ${baseUrl}, ${apiKey}, ${model}, ${extensionPath}.
setting.imageModels: Models that receive pasted images, e.g. ["fast"]. Empty: your school's list (the models its server marks as reading images).
setting.stateDirectory: Folder for your conversations, sessions and the agents' own files (absolute or under ~). Empty: ~/.local/state/<this extension's name>, the XDG state folder. Applies after a window reload.
capability.untrusted: The assistant runs an agent that reads, changes and runs files in this folder: it works in a folder you trust.
render.name: Rendered page (HTML)
setting.marimo: marimo to render notebooks with (a path). Empty: the one beside your default Python interpreter, else the PATH's.
